title: Part
spec: Start by creating a new coordinate system with Euler angles set to zero degrees and a translation vector also set to zero. Next, initiate a two-dimensional sketch on a new face. In this face, draw a single loop composed of ten lines. Begin with the first line from the origin at (0.0, 0.5257) to (0.021, 0.5257), followed by the second line from (0.021, 0.5257) to (0.021, 0.729). Continue with the third line from (0.021, 0.729) to (0.6764, 0.729), the fourth line from (0.6764, 0.729) to (0.6764, 0.021), and the fifth line from (0.6764, 0.021) to (0.4731, 0.021). Add the sixth line from (0.4731, 0.021) to (0.4731, 0.0), the seventh line from (0.4731, 0.0) to (0.6974, 0.0), the eighth line from (0.6974, 0.0) to (0.6974, 0.75), the ninth line from (0.6974, 0.75) to (0.0, 0.75), and finally, the tenth line from (0.0, 0.75) back to the starting point at (0.0, 0.5257). After completing the loop, apply a scaling factor of 0.75 to the entire sketch to reduce its size proportionally. Transform the scaled two-dimensional sketch into three dimensions using the same Euler angles and translation vector initially set. Extrude the two-dimensional sketch along the normal direction to a depth of 0.0491 meters and set the opposite extrusion depth to zero. This process will create a new solid body with a length of 0.6974 meters, a width of 0.75 meters, and a height of 0.0491 meters.

reference.label: Reference (dataset)
reference.code:
import cadquery as cq

# Define the sketch
sketch = cq.Workplane("XY").moveTo(0.0, 0.5257).lineTo(0.021, 0.5257).lineTo(0.021, 0.729).lineTo(0.6764, 0.729).lineTo(0.6764, 0.021).lineTo(0.4731, 0.021).lineTo(0.4731, 0.0).lineTo(0.6974, 0.0).lineTo(0.6974, 0.75).lineTo(0.0, 0.75).close()

# Extrude the sketch
extrusion = sketch.extrude(0.0491)

# Assign the final model to 'r'
r = extrusion

import cadquery as cq

t = 0.02
L = 0.6974
W = 0.7500
H = 0.0491

# Top bar (full width)
top_bar = cq.Workplane("XY").box(L, t, H, centered=False).translate((0, W - t, 0))

# Left leg (short, hanging down from top bar)
left_leg = cq.Workplane("XY").box(t, 0.24, H, centered=False).translate((0, W - t - 0.24, 0))

# Right leg (full depth)
right_leg = cq.Workplane("XY").box(t, W, H, centered=False).translate((L - t, 0, 0))

# Bottom foot (near the right side)
foot = cq.Workplane("XY").box(L - 0.474, t, H, centered=False).translate((0.474, 0, 0))

r = top_bar.union(left_leg).union(right_leg).union(foot)

lanes.label: Kimi K3 (high)
lanes.code:
import cadquery as cq

# Flat C-shaped clip (uniform sheet thickness), opening toward the left
X = 0.6974   # overall width (X)
Y = 0.7500   # overall depth (Y)
Z = 0.0491   # sheet thickness (Z)
t = 0.0200   # band width in plan
gap_x = 0.40 # free end of the shorter lower arm

# Right spine (full height)
spine = cq.Workplane("XY").box(t, Y, Z).translate((X - t / 2, Y / 2, Z / 2))

# Top arm (reaches the far left edge)
top = cq.Workplane("XY").box(X, t, Z).translate((X / 2, Y - t / 2, Z / 2))

# Bottom arm (shorter, leaves the left opening)
bottom_len = X - gap_x
bottom = cq.Workplane("XY").box(bottom_len, t, Z).translate(((gap_x + X) / 2, t / 2, Z / 2))

r = spine.union(top).union(bottom)
